parameters.name: ChannelName
parameters.description: The name of the network channel. The name must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start and end with a letter or a digit. The name can be up to 64 characters long.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that ensures the request is idempotent. The client generates this token. The token must be unique for each request. It is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The name of the source instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: TargetDBClusterId
parameters.description: The name of the destination instance.

parameters.name: TargetIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the destination instance.

parameters.name: TargetPort
parameters.description: The port of the destination instance.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.
